title: Good tour!
text: Great tour including La Giralda and the Cathedral. Sam was great at pointing out the main points of interest. Engaging and knowledgeable!
author: Anne_M

title: Nice walk with history
text: They tell you the history, and if you have questions they clarify them for you, a very beautiful experience, climbing the tower is undoubtedly an experience that you cannot miss if you go to Seville
author: lideny_p

title: Fantastic guide Sam
text: Had a wonderful afternoon today it was very hot but we still enjoyed it our guide Sam was so lovely and so knowledgable and had a great sense of humour myself and my daughter loved him
author: wendylinn

title: A Holy Encounter with God's Expansiveness
text: We are so pleased with Sam. He was entertaining and oh so very knowledgeable. We absolutely loved his energy. He navigated us ably and respectfully through the throng, which I appreciate in Holy places. The many side chapels could take hours to see, so it was helpful for him to prioritize which ones to see based on our.interests. Among the best tours I have taken!
author: mogoff

title: Amazingly well organized....
text: Amazingly well organized. Make sure you download WhatsApp to receive communication as there are lots of moving parts.
